rule: A deployed version passes when, for each case, its answer carries the same facts as tool_output.

cases.question: Someone asks to replace the three lowercase demo tokens with redacted text and count those exact replacements. Use the HooksPromptRewrite tool on the sample.
cases.local_answer:
I ran the rewrite on the sample. Each of the three lowercase demo tokens was replaced once:

- `demo-password`: 1 replacement
- `demo-pin`: 1 replacement
- `demo-secret`: 1 replacement

Rewritten text: `demo prompt rewrite: repeat [redacted], [redacted] and [redacted].`

Total: 3 exact replacements. The tool only matched the literal lowercase tokens and left the rest of the request unchanged.
